messages:
maya: Quick follow-up from last night's postmortem about the cache thrash incident — we agreed to add regression suites and a couple of chaos drills. Quick sync to assign owners and timelines?
kevin: I'm happy to own the regression suite for KV cache warm/cold and eviction edge cases. Will aim for a PR in ~2 weeks.
sanjay: I can take chaos drills + network partition tests. Will need to coordinate with eng-sre for runbook integration. Target: runbook + automated job by Apr 10.
eva: I'll add prompt-set regressions to the evals harness for the two user flows that regressed. Need the specific prompts and golden outputs from the incident logs @maya.
maya: Incident notes & snippets: <https://redwood.internal/incidents/incident-2026-03-21-cache-kv-thrash|incident-2026-03-21>. Sample prompts pasted below in case folks need quick access. Also want an invariant: throughput regression >20% should fail the smoke.
apsara: Can we add a lightweight nightly load test against the dedicated pool (small scale) to catch queuing/backpressure? I can wire it into CI tomorrow.
oncall-bot: Incident summary posted: incident-2026-03-21-cached-kv-thrash — retro due in 3 days.
kevin: For the regression PR template I suggest: dataset + how it was derived, repro steps, failure thresholds, CI tags, and a short rationale. I'll draft and open a PR this week.
sanjay: Chaos drill plan sketch: 1) rolling pod restarts 2) 99% CPU spike on workers 3) egress latency injection. Run against canary + a small dedicated slice. Need approval from eng-sre / @lucy to run on staging first.
eva: Prompt sets: I'll convert them to evals YAML with golden responses. Proposed thresholds: semantic sim (sbert_cosine) > 0.85, token-level overlap > 0.7 as a start. We can tune after first run.
maya: Agree on thresholds. Also add console alerts when eval score drops >5% from baseline and link to the incident ticket.
apsara: Nightly load job label: `nightly/incident-regress`. I'll cap it to 100 concurrent clients to avoid impacting other tenants.
devops: We need a service account + RBAC to run chaos tests safely. I can create `svc-chaos-runner`, need owners and a brief runbook entry.
kevin: Owners summary for clarity: regression-suite -> @kevin, chaos-drill -> @sanjay, prompt-evals -> @eva, nightly-load -> @apsara, RBAC/service-account -> @devops.
maya: Recording action items and rough ETA: KEVIN (2w), SANJAY (3w), EVA (10d), APSARA (48h for CI job), DEVOPS (48h to provision). Follow-up sync next Wed 10am PT. @everyone please tag any PRs with `incident-1840009876`.
sanjay: :thumbsup: I'll ping @lucy for staging approvals and also propose a recurring ticket to track the "cache thrash" pattern monthly (so we see regressions over time).
eva: I'll drop prompt seeds + examples under `evals/incident/1840009876/` and open a PR later today.
maya: Thanks all — if you hit blockers DM me. Closing thread shortly.
